name: Grimtotem Satchel
summary: Deep beneath Orgrimmar, Grimtotem Satchel remains in Maur Grimtotem’s grasp. Troggs killed the tauren in Ragefire Chasm, but he shielded the pouch as he died. Its return to Thunder Bluff brings Magatha Grimtotem’s interest to light.

sections.title: A Dying Grip
sections.body: Maur Grimtotem fell to troggs deep inside Ragefire Chasm, beneath Orgrimmar. The tauren still clutched the simple leather pack when his body was found. He had fought to protect it while the troggs surrounded him. What could it hold that made him guard it with his life?

sections.title: The Elder Crone's Interest
sections.body: Rahauro on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff accepts the satchel for Magatha Grimtotem, matriarch of the Grimtotem clan. Maur served Magatha, and word had reached her that he found something peculiar in the caverns beneath Orgrimmar before he died. She arranged a reward for the pack’s safe return. The Grimtotem leader had a clear interest in what Maur found.

faq.q: Where is the Grimtotem Satchel found?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem Satchel was found beneath Maur Grimtotem’s body, deep inside Ragefire Chasm, the volcanic cavern beneath Orgrimmar. His arms still held it where troggs killed him.

faq.q: Who does the satchel belong to?
faq.answer: The satchel belonged to Maur Grimtotem, a member of the Grimtotem clan who entered Ragefire Chasm. He held it close as troggs attacked.
Rahauro on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff accepts the satchel for Magatha Grimtotem. Magatha arranged a reward for the return of her fallen clansman’s belongings.

faq.q: Why was a Grimtotem carrying this under Orgrimmar?
aliases: what was the grimtotem doing in orgrimmar
faq.answer: Maur Grimtotem served Magatha Grimtotem, who took an interest in Ragefire Chasm. He went there to speak with the troggs and found something peculiar, but died before he could show it to her.
The pouch’s contents remain sealed when Rahauro receives it in Thunder Bluff. Magatha hopes it holds signs of the peculiar thing Maur found in the chasm.

angles.text: A Grimtotem went deep beneath Orgrimmar, then word of what he found reached Magatha on the Elder Rise. The clan’s moves within the united tauren tribes are quiet and uneasy.
A dead Grimtotem courier lay deep in the tunnels beneath Thrall’s capital. Ragefire Chasm holds dangers beyond its beasts.
